title: Crunchyroll U.K. Home Releases Schedule Update
content: In a press release, Crunchyroll added several UK home releases in December, including a Blu-ray Steelbook of the second season of The Apothecary Diaries on December 14. Crunchyroll 's full schedule is as follows: October 26 Sailor Moon (Season 1) Steelbook (Blu-ray), pictured right.

title: DJ, Voice Actress Eriko Nakamura Performs in Bengaluru at Japan Habba 2027
content: Singer May Nakabayashi , best known as the singing voice of Macross Frontier 's Sheryl Nome under her stage name May'n , will be the headliner for the 2027 event and the event will also host voice actor Kanna Nakamura as a guest. The event will host Love Live! Sunshine!! voice actress Kanako Takatsuki as a guest.
author: ANN

title: AFA Singapore Screens Asian Premiere of Bless TV Anime
content: The AFA Singapore convention announced on Thursday that it will screen the Asian premiere of the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga. The screening will take place at the convention's NEXT Stage on November 27.
author: ANN

title: QCinema Film Festival Screns Live-Action Look Back Film in the Philippines
content: The QCinema International Film Festival in Quezon City, Metro Manila announced on Friday that it will screen the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot as the closing film of the festival.
author: ANN

title: Odex to Theatrically Screen Detective Conan 2-Hour Anime Special in Singapore, Philippines
content: Odex announced on Thursday that it will screen Detective Conan: 30-gō Satsujin Jiken (The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30) , the franchise 's first new two-hour special in 10 years, in cinemas in Singapore and the Philippines.
author: ANN

title: Muse Asia Licenses I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World 2nd Season Anime
content: Muse Asia announced on Wednesday that it has licensed the second season of the anime based on Miku and illustrator Rein Kuwashima 's I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World ( Isekai de Cheat Skill o Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai o mo Musōsuru ) light novel series, and will stream the anime in January 2027.

title: Tokyo Revengers Gets Pop-Up Stores in Seoul, Taipei, Bangkok
content: Pony Canyon announced on Tuesday that it will hold "Tokyo Revengers BAKUSO POP UP ASIA TOUR," a pop-up store tour, in Seoul, Taipei, and Bangkok to celebrate the recent debut of Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc ( Tokyo Revengers: Santen Sensō-hen ), the latest arc of the Tokyo Revengers anime.
author: ANN

title: Permanent London Pokémon Store Will Open By 2029
content: The upcoming London store is described as being "the first physical retail space for the Pokémon brand outside of Asia." However, the announcement also adds that the London store will be the first of several permanent Pokémon stores which are planned to open in locations outside Asia.
author: ANN
